author: Michael Jenkins
text: Austin Installed my whole house water filtration system and a tankless water heater in my house. Did an excellent job. Would definitely recommend Little city Plumbing again for my next project.

author: Dave Andress
text: Austin provided great service to to fix a leakage problem under my sink.

author: Jeremy Preusser
text: Austin came over to my house and said I needed to get a new valve for my sink. He gave me a price and walked to his truck to get the valve. He didn’t have it so he’d need to go to Lowe’s and pick one up. Austin mentioned he had a busy day and I decided that maybe Wednesday morning would be best so he doesn’t have to rush. Austin offered Wednesday morning and I agreed. Well come Wednesday morning no call and no show to my house and my sink is still leaking. Absolutely terrible customer service and never make an appointment with someone and no call no show them. Bad business!!!

author: Don Desanto
text: Woke up to a water leak and Austin was at our home by 8:30 the same morning.. Great guy & terrific service!

author: Kelly Avgerinos
text: Austin was great and as plumbing experiences go, this was amazingly professional, personable and reasonably priced! I would totally recommend Austin’s Little City Plumbing business to anyone in need of a good, steady, reliable, professional and personable plumber.
